data.caveat: RULE 11 / MEDIATOR-CREDIBILITY CAVEAT: the ~$100M figure is negotiation posture, not a damages calculation. NEVER pled, never in a filing, demand letter, or mediation statement as computed damages or an expected outcome — asserting it as computed damages risks Rule 11 exposure and destroys mediator credibility. Requires ALL seven Tier-3 assumptions in damages_model.json to break plaintiff's way, including no remittitur — historically the least likely of all.

posture_markers.label: NEGOTIATION POSTURE — exposure-ceiling anchor (ASSERTED)
posture_markers.caveat: RULE 11 / MEDIATOR-CREDIBILITY CAVEAT: negotiation posture, not a damages calculation. Communicated only as the runaway-jury exposure a self-insured/carrier-advised defendant must weight by probability, constructed transparently from the Tier-3 arithmetic. Never pled, never in any filing or mediation statement as computed damages; any figure placed in a pleading or demand must trace to the Tier-1/Tier-2 evidence-labeled arithmetic.

posture_markers.label: NEGOTIATION POSTURE — acceptance threshold, per client directive (ASSERTED)
posture_markers.caveat: Same RULE 11 / MEDIATOR-CREDIBILITY CAVEAT. HONESTY FLAG: ~2.4x the top of the verified-law Tier-2 range ($16.57M) and ~9x its floor — a client-instructed negotiating position, not a number the model supports as a probable verdict; a mediator will price the case off Tier 2, not off this number. Counsel must own the gap explicitly.

posture_markers.label: Floor / BATNA — Tier 1 documented core
posture_markers.caveat: Do not accept below the documented core absent non-monetary relief of equivalent value to the client's first-order objectives (clean academic record, board-safe verification letters, USCIS-usable stipulation, reference protocol, institutional reform). BATNA below the floor: litigate to verdict — fee-shifting compounds defendants' cost of delay toward the November 2026 mediation deadline.

notes: Evidence labels per damages_model.json honesty_rules: DOCUMENTED (record in hand or hash-chained), ESTIMABLE (methodology + records identified, computation pending), ASSERTED (client statement or posture figure without independent support).

ANTI-DOUBLE-COUNT: paternal loans (~$900K) and living expenses (~$1M) are excluded from all tier totals (in_totals=false) — they are the same dollars as the lost-income gap the Florida contract measures; corroboration and hardship narrative only.

Single-recovery rule: the same lost-income dollars cannot be recovered under multiple counts; the multi-count structure widens liability paths, not the compensatory pot. Tier 2 replaces the Tier-1 lost-salary line with back pay and carries the remaining Tier-1 items as out_of_pocket_consequentials — the tiers are alternative framings, never additive.

Remedy channeling (post-Cummings): emotional distress never under Title VI/Rehab/FMLA (Cummings CL 6463720); punitives never under Title VI (Barnes CL 121152) or FMLA. NYSHRL and FMLA counts are NOT YET PLED — amendment required.
